# Aker ökar i Sveafastigheter – förvaltaren om Volvo-kritiken

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-10-06  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon spoke with SEB fund manager Tommy Saukoripi, who takes a long-term (3-5 year) view of quality Nordic companies with strong balance sheets. He defended Volvo against criticism of its customer-financing model and stayed positive on the Nordic banks. He added to Nordea, Danske Bank, Ericsson and AstraZeneca, and took profits in Investor AB and sold all of Industrivärden after their discounts turned to premiums. The episode also covered rising long-term interest rates, weak German factory orders, Mandatum's purchase of Cliens, Octave's volatile trading since its spin-off from Hexagon, and analyst rating changes on Nordea, Handelsbanken and Lyko.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 VOLV-B — Volvo | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Third-largest SEB fund holding. Manager defends the business model and net cash, and takes a 3-5 year view despite weak recent trading.

#### Reasoning

Guest (SEB manager Tommy Saukoripi) keeps Volvo as a top holding. It is a well-run company with significant net cash, Volvo Financial Services is profitable, and returns over 3-10 years are strong. Weak German orders, weak truck order data, rising rates and fuel prices may slow activity in the short term, but he focuses on 3-5 year cash flows and competitiveness.

#### Sell Triggers

- if counterparty/credit risk in customer financing deteriorates
- if competitive position weakens over 3-5 years
- if prolonged freight/GDP downturn erodes profitability

> *"det är ju ett väldigt välskött bolag som stått sig väl och vi var inne på balansräkningar, bolaget har fortfarande en betydande nettokassa"*

---

### 🟢 NDA-SE — Nordea | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

SEB fund added because Nordea has lagged other banks. SB1 Markets (cited analyst) upgraded it from neutral to buy.

#### Reasoning

The guest added to Nordea after its relative underperformance. He sees the bank sector as attractive on valuation, with strong balance sheets that support dividends and buybacks, and rising rates help earnings. A broker upgrade (SB1 Markets) supports this independently.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rate levels start triggering credit losses
- if credit demand weakens materially

> *"Nordea har ju släpat lite grann på sistone jämfört med de andra bankerna. Så då har vi passat på att fylla på lite."*

---

### 🔴 SHB-A — Handelsbanken | **SELL** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

SB1 Markets (cited analyst) downgraded Handelsbanken from neutral to sell.

#### Reasoning

This signal comes only from a cited broker rating change by SB1 Markets. The guest did not comment on Handelsbanken specifically and holds all four Nordic big banks.

#### Sell Triggers

- if broker reverses the downgrade
- if relative valuation becomes attractive

> *"Handelsbanken justeras ner från neutral och säljstämplas nu"*

---

### 🟢 DANSKE — Danske Bank | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Added to the SEB fund on top of the Nordic big banks. Strong 12-month share-price performance.

#### Reasoning

The guest added Danske to his bank exposure. He sees stable risk-adjusted potential for banks, with rising rates supporting earnings and strong balance sheets supporting dividends and buybacks.

#### Sell Triggers

- if credit losses rise as rates climb
- if bank valuations re-rate fully

> *"vi har dessutom kryddat anrättningen med Danske"*

---

### 🟡 SWED-A — Swedbank | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Has risen strongly and is now relatively more expensive, but its Baltic position offers growth.

#### Reasoning

The guest notes that Swedbank's strong run makes it relatively dearer than peers, which implies a lower weighting. He still sees support from Baltic credit and savings growth and low leverage among Baltic households and companies.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Baltic growth slows
- if valuation premium widens further

> *"Swedbank har gått riktigt starkt. Så att relativt sett har den blivit något dyrare."*

---

### 🟢 OCTAVE — Octave | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Valuation implies little growth while recurring revenue rises. Schneider's purchase of TPC at much higher multiples shows the potential.

#### Reasoning

The guest says Octave has developed in line with its sector since the Hexagon spin-off, despite AI fears and selling by shareholders who received shares in the spin-off. A rising share of recurring revenue and a strong technical position, combined with a valuation that prices in no growth, give reasonable upside. The Schneider–TPC deal at much higher multiples is a reference point.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI disrupts its software business model
- if recurring revenue share stalls
- if it falls behind technologically

> *"värderingen implicerar att bolaget inte kommer att ha någon större tillväxt att tala om på sikt... Då borde det finnas en rimlig uppsida."*

---

### 🟢 ERIC-B — Ericsson | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Fund bought in spring and has increased since. Lower valuation, focus on shareholder value and buybacks, EU limits on Huawei, defence upside.

#### Reasoning

The guest re-entered Ericsson after nearly two decades without it. Reasons: a lower valuation, a shift from acquisitions (Vonage was a failure) to buying back its own shares, EU moves to restrict Huawei that should ease competition, and defence opportunities such as counter-drone systems. He sees growth options that look cheap at the current valuation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if management returns to value-destroying M&A
- if EU fails to restrict Huawei
- if new CEO changes capital allocation focus

> *"Allt det här tycker vi skapar en del tillväxtmöjligheter som ju inte ser särskilt dyrt ut när man betänker värderingen."*

---

### 🟢 AZN — AstraZeneca | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Fund increased its position. Defensive, with a broad R&D pipeline and an undemanding valuation. BMS deal rumours were a concern.

#### Reasoning

The guest added to AstraZeneca as a defensive counterweight to AI-driven stocks. It has one of the broadest research pipelines in the sector and an undemanding valuation. Talk of a possible BMS mega-deal hurt confidence, and AstraZeneca later backed away from it. Some setbacks in product development so far do not overturn the investment case.

#### Sell Triggers

- if management pursues large dilutive M&A
- if major pipeline failures occur

> *"Astra har en väldigt bred forskningsportfölj. Kanske en av de allra bredaste i sektorn. Samtidigt som värderingen inte heller är särskilt utmanande"*

---

### 🟡 INVE-B — Investor AB | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Trimmed after the shares moved to a noticeable premium to NAV. Still a very large holding.

#### Reasoning

The guest took some profit because, by his estimate, Investor trades at a premium to net asset value. That estimate depends on how Patricia Industries is valued. The position remains large, so this is a trim-and-hold rather than an exit.

#### Sell Triggers

- if NAV premium widens further

> *"i våra ögon så hade det blivit en viss men ändå märkbar premie när det gällde substansen. Då passade vi på att ta lite vinst."*

---

### 🔴 INDU-C — Industrivärden | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Sold completely after its NAV discount turned into a premium. Money moved into underlying holdings such as Ericsson.

#### Reasoning

The guest exited Industrivärden entirely. Because its whole portfolio is listed, the premium to NAV is easy to measure. He prefers to own the underlying companies directly.

> *"När den rabatten förbyttes i en premie passade vi på att öka på vissa av de underliggande innehållen istället, däribland Ericsson."*

---

### 🟢 LYKO-A — Lyko | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Pareto (cited analyst) upgraded it from hold to buy. The stock rose up to about 7% before falling back to about 3%.

#### Reasoning

This signal comes only from Pareto's broker upgrade, reported by the host. There was no guest view, and the initial jump faded during the morning.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the upgrade-driven gain fades fully

> *"Lyko är upp närmare. 7 procent. Där har Pareto höjt rekommendationen till köp från tidigare behåll."*

---

### 🟠 NOKIA — Nokia | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Held in SEB's Nordic fund. Trades at a >100% EV premium to Ericsson, so a lot of expectations are priced in.

#### Reasoning

The guest owns Nokia in another fund but warns that the Nvidia-driven rally has left it at more than double Ericsson's EV multiples, compared with roughly equal multiples historically. That leaves high expectations to meet.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI growth expectations disappoint

> *"Idag har ju Nokia en premie på över 100 % så att man kan ju säga utan vidare att det finns en hel del förväntningar inbakade i den värderingen."*

---
